maya: quick accessibility pass on the new "callouts" panel. found several keyboard/VO issues in dark theme. attaching notes. maya: main problem: model selector looks and behaves like buttons but should be a radio group. focus ring disappears at certain zoom levels and VoiceOver reads 'button' for each item. devon: thanks, can you share repro steps? i couldn't repro on my machine. maya: repro: dark theme, 150% zoom, tab into panel, then tab across the model options. you should see the selected item lacks a distinct focus outline. Figma link: https://figma.redwood.design/file/DEF456/callouts-panel sophie: sounds like a combo of CSS focus styling and missing ARIA roles. quick fixes: make focus-visible use a high-contrast color token and add proper role attributes (radiogroup/radio). devon: example CSS i'll try: ```css .callout-option:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-yellow-500); outline-offset: 2px; } ``` sophie: good. markup should also be updated so assistive tech announces radios correctly. e.g. role="radiogroup" on wrapper, each item role="radio" + aria-checked and manage tabindex. maya: another issue: when a user clicks an option with a mouse, keyboard focus doesn't move to that option, so keyboard users get out-of-sync. tabindex management needs to be fixed. devon: plan: update click handler to set tabindex=0 on clicked item, set others to -1, and call element.focus(). will include unit tests. jorge: UX note: when model changes we should give a polite SR announcement like "Model set to Medium. Estimated latency ~120ms." not intrusive. aria-live=polite is fine. keep phrasing short. sophie: agree — aria-atomic and polite. avoid raw fluctuating numbers; round to nearest 50ms to reduce noise. maya: code suggestion for announcer region: ```html
``` devon: good call. question: should arrow keys move between options like native radios? sophie: yes, follow WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices: left/right or up/down should move and set aria-checked. also Home/End behavior helpful for long lists. maya: QA checklist i put in the Figma comment: - VoiceOver: items announced as radio with checked state - NVDA & ChromeVox: consistent announcements - Focus ring visible in light/dark at 200% zoom - Arrow keys change selection and update aria-checked + tabindex - Mouse click sets focus and updates tabindex - SR polite announcement triggers only once per change devon: will PR with markup, CSS, keyboard handlers, and SR announcer. tagging @aria-bot to run a11y-lint. aria-bot: a11y-lint queued for branch 'fix/callouts-radio-a11y' — checking roles, focus styles, contrast, and aria-live usage. CI report will follow. jorge: small copy tweak for announcer: prefer "Model switched to Medium" over "set to" for brevity. maya: noted. i'll update the Figma notes and the aria examples. thanks everyone :thumbsup: devon: i'll push WIP later today. anyone want to pair on the keyboard test matrix? sophie: i can help tomorrow morning. maya: perfect — i'll review the PR once it's up.
